name: Hantana Tea Estate
description: Discover the serene Hantana Tea Estate, nestled among lush tea plantations and ancient bungalows. This historic estate offers a glimpse into Sri Lanka’s tea-making traditions and cultural heritage, perfect for tea enthusiasts and nature lovers alike.
activities: Explore tea plantation trails, Visit historic bungalows, Learn about tea making process

name: Loolecondera Tea Estate
description: Loolecondera Tea Estate, nestled amidst lush tea plantations and verdant hills, offers visitors a glimpse into the traditional Ceylonese way of life. This estate, known for its pristine environment and historical significance, attracts nature lovers and tea enthusiasts alike with its serene landscapes and cultural heritage.
activities: Tea plantation tour, bird watching, photography

name: Udawatte Tea Garden
description: Udawatte Tea Garden, nestled amidst lush tea plantations in Kandy’s Central Province, offers visitors a serene escape with its panoramic views and historical significance. This estate, established over a century ago, is a testament to Sri Lanka’s rich tea culture and traditional practices.
activities: Explore tea plantation trails, Learn about tea cultivation, Visit the historic estate house

name: Madulkelle Tea Resort
description: Madulkelle Tea Resort is a serene tea estate nestled in the lush Kandy hills, offering visitors a glimpse into the traditional Sri Lankan tea-making process and a chance to experience the tranquility of rural life.
activities: Explore the tea plantation, Visit the local tea museum, Enjoy tea tasting
monsoon_note: Heavy rain May–Aug; mist at high elevations

name: Corbett's Gap Estate
description: Corbett's Gap Estate stands majestically in Kandy’s Central Province, offering panoramic views of the surrounding tea plantations and verdant hills. This historic estate, steeped in colonial charm, provides visitors with a glimpse into Sri Lanka’s rich agricultural heritage.
activities: Explore tea gardens, learn about estate history, enjoy scenic views
